items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-10: Remedies: modern and traditional
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Write a conversation asking a trusted adult for help when you feel unwell. Do not prescribe medicine or a home remedy.
items.explanation:
Child: I do not feel well. Could you help me?
Adult: Of course. Tell me what you are feeling.
Child: I have a headache, and I feel tired.
Adult: Thank you for telling me. We will arrange appropriate advice and care.
Child: Should I take something from the medicine cupboard?
Adult: Do not take medicine on your own. Let us ask a qualified health professional.
Child: All right. I will stay with you and explain if I feel worse.
Adult: Yes. You do not have to manage this alone.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original safety-oriented language model, not a diagnosis or treatment plan. Serious or worsening symptoms need prompt professional assessment.
